elements.element: Renewal requires mutual written agreement unless every conditional automatic-renewal element below is met.
elements.evidence: Inserted language makes renewal automatic ("shall renew automatically for successive renewal terms of twelve (12) months each"), so the mutual-agreement alternative is not required provided each conditional automatic-renewal element is satisfied — and each of the 12-month term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder and CPI/3% cap is expressly stated.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term is no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: "successive renewal terms of twelve (12) months each".

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer may opt out on no more than 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: "unless Sparkling gives Garman written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term" — Customer-side opt-out at a 30-day window.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer at least 60 days before renewal.
elements.evidence: "Garman shall remind Sparkling of the upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term."

elements.element: If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and 3 percent.
elements.evidence: "Maintenance fees for any renewal term shall not increase by more than the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index during the then-current term and three percent (3%)."

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: The 30-day non-renewal notice window is within the 60-day fallback ceiling.

elements.element: If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
elements.evidence: The lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap is necessarily at or below 5 percent.

reasons: All five preferred elements are met by the single inserted sentence-block; the fallback parameters are satisfied a fortiori.

The insertion is a concise new renewal mechanic added after the existing maintenance-term sentence; no existing words were deleted or paraphrased, and the perpetual-licence and Fee Schedule provisions are retained verbatim.

No extras beyond the checklist: no survival tail, no expense allocation, no added remedies or procedures; the CPI measurement period ('during the then-current term') is the minimum specificity needed to make the cap operable rather than an undefined trigger.

Intent preserved: the maintenance term remains subject to the Fee Schedule, the perpetual licence in (a) is untouched, and the automatic-renewal mechanic does not contradict the retained 'renewable one-year term' language — it supplies the missing renewal detail consistent with it.
No walk-away feature is created (renewal term is 12 months, notice window is 30 days, well under 90).
